newsitem.title: INDIA: India makes 16.75 mln T finished steel in Apr-Dec.
newsitem.headline: India makes 16.75 mln T finished steel in Apr-Dec.

text.p: India produced 16.75 million tonnes of finished steel between April and December, up 14.4 percent from 14.64 million in the same period in 1995, the Steel Ministry said on Friday.
It said in a statement that pig iron production during April to December was 2.43 million tonnes as against 2.03 million in the same period in 1995.
India exported 720,000 tonnes of finished steel during April to December, compared to 547,000 tonnes in the same period in 1995, the statement said.
Finished steel consumption in the April-December period was estimated at 16.50 million tonnes, a 11.7 percent increase over the corresponding period in 1995.
The statement said pig iron consumption between April and December was 1.90 million tonnes, a 13.1 percent increase over the corresponding period in 1995.
